note: Every story below was published/dated Thursday 26 November 2026 (UTC), or is a new development first reported that day. Sources consulted on 26 Nov 2026: One Turn world-news digest for 26 Nov 2026 (65 stories, crawled 07:00 UTC); Reuters world news summary (updated 26-11-2026); The Japan Times latest-news desk (items stamped Nov 26, 2026); The Economic Times world desk (Nov 26, 2026); Qatar Tribune world page (Nov 26, 2026); Champions League match reports dated 26 Nov 2026. Excluded on the date check: items from 25 Nov repeated without a new 26 Nov development (Huawei verdict, Chen Jining probe, Australia-Solomon Islands treaty, North Korea expelling the Swiss envoy, Senegal's CAS title) and the 24 Nov Gaza strike.
